## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3 (impl-plan Steps 2/4/6 slice): touchpoint review-artifact test passes asserting cycles[] for each of Steps 2/4/6
- dd-6 (impl-plan Steps 2/4/6 slice): single ticket comment per cycle references artifact path — Steps 2/4/6

## Testing Mode
RED (bundled: create test + edit SKILL.md — Gate 2)

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md (Edit — Steps 2/4/6 re-dispatch blocks)
- tests/scripts/test-impl-plan-step-cycles.sh (Create)

## Implementation Notes
Edit implementation-plan/SKILL.md Steps 2, 4, and 6 Remediation Re-dispatch subsections (added by story 9d49-662f-e21b-418a) to call append_review_cycle.py after each cycle + emit one ticket comment referencing artifact path. Each step gets the same two-call pattern. Add single-comment-policy prose at each step.

Shell pattern to add in each Step's re-dispatch block:
python3 plugins/dso/scripts/append_review_cycle.py --artifact <path> --n <n> --draft-hash <hash> --findings-count <count> --verdict <verdict>
.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment <ticket-id> "Remediation cycle <n> recorded at <artifact-path>"

## Cross-story dependency
This task requires the Step 2/4/6 Remediation Re-dispatch subsections from story 9d49-662f-e21b-418a to exist in SKILL.md before adding cycles[] calls inside them.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. tests/scripts/test-impl-plan-step-cycles.sh exists and is executable
2. test 0 -ge 3 → passes (one per Step 2/4/6)
3. test 1 -ge 3 → passes
4. grep -qi 'not duplicat\|references the artifact path' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md → found
5. Test asserts that all 3 step sections (Step 2, Step 4, Step 6) contain append_review_cycle.py calls
6. Run: bash tests/scripts/test-impl-plan-step-cycles.sh → PASS
data.title: Wire cycles[] append + single-comment policy into implementation-plan Steps 2/4/6 re-dispatch blocks
